sentences.text: Çdo ditë Ardi shkon në shkollë.
sentences.english: Every day Ardi goes to school.
Today Ardi cannot find the key.
It is not on the table.
It is not in the bag.
It is not in the room.
The cat is in the kitchen.
Look, the cat has the key!

sentences.text: Ardi është i lumtur që gjen çelësin.
sentences.english: Ardi is happy that he finds the key.

sentences.text: Ai shkon në shkollë me gjyshin.
sentences.english: He goes to school with his grandfather.

sentences.text: Sam ka një libër në shqip.
sentences.english: Sam has a book in Albanian.

sentences.text: Sot Sam nuk e gjen librin.
sentences.english: Today Sam cannot find the book.

sentences.text: — Luan, ku është libri im? — pyet Sam.
sentences.english: "Luan, where is my book?" asks Sam.

sentences.text: Ai e sheh librin mbi tavolinë.
sentences.english: He sees the book on the table.

sentences.text: Sam e lexon librin në kuzhinë.
sentences.english: Sam reads the book in the kitchen.

sentences.text: Elira ka një libër të ri.
Sot Elira nuk e gjen librin.
sentences.english: Today Elira cannot find the book.

sentences.text: — Ku është libri im? — pyet Elira.
Nëna e sheh librin mbi tavolinë.
sentences.english: The mother sees the book on the table.
"Here is your book!" says the mother.
She gives the book to Elira.

sentences.text: Elira është e lumtur që gjen librin.
sentences.english: Elira is happy that she finds the book.
